_note: Per-platform posting and outreach caps so the daily volume never trips a throttle. Platforms do not publish hard numbers; these are conservative working limits from Pat's own testing (YouTube Shorts throttled him to zero at ~20/day) and widely reported account-safety guidance. Adjust in this file; the app reads it on boot.

platforms.name: TikTok
platforms.notes: No practical posting cap in Pat's testing. Add trending audio inside TikTok. Set the cover to the hook frame, add location + hashtags after posting.

platforms.name: Instagram
platforms.notes: Reels only (not Stories) for reach; auto-share to Facebook + Story. More than ~3 reels/day dilutes reach and repeated bursts read as spam. Follow/unfollow bursts get action-blocked: spread adds through the day.

platforms.name: Facebook
platforms.notes: Most reels arrive via Instagram auto-share; post the with-music version to the FB Story by hand. Friend requests are the most throttle-sensitive action on Facebook: 10-15/day, only people with mutual friends, never a batch.

platforms.name: YouTube Shorts
platforms.notes: Pat's hard finding: ~20 Shorts in a day was throttled to zero views. Once, maybe twice a day. Upload the NO-MUSIC master and add the song from YouTube's own library.

platforms.name: LinkedIn
platforms.notes: Optional. One post a day at most; connection requests are capped weekly (about 100), so 10-15/day is the ceiling.

platforms.name: Facebook Marketplace
platforms.notes: One home per day (open houses on Friday). Seller-program graphic as photos 2-3. Duplicate listings of the same home in one day get removed.

reel_distribution._note: How Friday's 10 reels spread across platforms so no platform exceeds its cap. Order = posting order, one per hour from 08:00.
